items.title: Agentic CCaaS: The new category for contact center platforms, and why it matters
items.summary: For nearly a decade, contact center as a service (CCaaS) platforms were judged on the same few things: uptime, channel coverage, and cost per agent seat. Those capabilities are now table stakes. As AI agents take on more customer conversations, a new question matters more: can the platform coordinate work across AI agents, human agents, […]
